'''SoapBox Credentials''' is a directory that maps the free and low-cost credential paths the wider world already offers — industry by industry — and shows where the ecosystem's own Academy fits alongside them. It is an honest orientation tool: most of what it points to belongs to established institutions, not to [[SoapBox]], and the directory says so plainly.

== What it maps ==
Organized by field, it gathers routes to real credentials that cost little or nothing:
* Free and low-cost certificate programs, MOOCs, and open courseware.
* Industry certifications, apprenticeship and licensing paths, and CLEP/exam-for-credit options.
* Where each path actually leads — what a given credential is worth and to whom.
This complements [[Autodidacts and Credentials]], which is the deeper reference on teaching yourself and getting recognized for it.

== Where the Academy fits ==
The ecosystem's own credential Academy is one entry in this larger map, not the whole map. The directory is deliberately outward-looking: it sends you to the best available path, whoever runs it, rather than steering everything back inward.

Browse it at [https://credentials.soapbox.community credentials.soapbox.community].

== How it fits ==
Credentials sits in the learning corner of [[SoapBox]], next to the [https://witness.melek.salon Witness School] and this [[The Library of Ashurbanipal|library]]. Knowledge is free to acquire; this vertical helps you turn it into something the world will recognize.
